Bug_Title: Constructor injection should be used instead of field injection
Bug_Explanation: The code uses field injection instead of constructor injection, which can lead to a NullPointerException when the class is instantiated by a caller. This is because the dependency (MyCollaborator) is not injected into the field, resulting in a null reference when attempting to use it.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method calls the showBug method of MyComponent, which results in a NullPointerException because the MyCollaborator instance is not injected via constructor injection as required.
